table.description: The table name, as DynamoDB spells it.

index.description: A global or local secondary index to query instead of the table.

filter.description: FilterExpression, applied after the key condition.

projection.description: ProjectionExpression: the attributes to return, such as "id, #s, total".

names.description: ExpressionAttributeNames: placeholders such as {"#s": "status"} for attribute names in the expressions.

values.description: ExpressionAttributeValues as DynamoDB typed values, such as {":id": {"S": "c-42"}, ":n": {"N": "10"}}.

ascending.description: Sort-key order: false for newest first.

consistent.description: Strongly consistent read (not on a global index). Default: the connection's setting.

limit.description: Most items to return; the endpoint caps it.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous answer; leave it out for the first page.
